faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JNCASR Project Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Project Secretary post at JNCASR is 25 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Secretary post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Secretary position at Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for JNCASR Project Secretary recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the JNCASR Project Secretary recruitment is Email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Secretary post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Secretary post at JNCASR is 35 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Project Secretary position at JNCASR?
faq.answer: The Project Secretary position at JNCASR offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month. This is a contract-based position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Project Secretary post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university with at least 02 years of proven work experience as an Office Assistant or Admin Assistant to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for JNCASR Project Secretary recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the JNCASR Project Secretary recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Secretary post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JNCASR Project Secretary post primarily involves an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Project Secretary post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Secretary position is Bengaluru, Karnataka. JNCASR is located in Bengaluru, and the selected candidate will be required to work there.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of JNCASR?
faq.answer: The official website for Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is www.jncasr.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates.
